cycles.title: JANUS Tear quotient falsification and policy-system split
cycles.result: The universal continuation-complete Tear quotient was destroyed. The surviving route was narrowed to one explicit selected-state algorithm and then split into a no-cache policy with a Resolution-lifting target and a caching policy requiring its own proof-system classification.
cycles.claim_boundary: C020 does not prove P=NP or P!=NP. The finite policy envelope failures are not asymptotic lower bounds, and the formula-caching simulation edge remains open.
